title: Warm Wood Fired Ethiopian Chicken Bake
description: A charred and snappy Ethiopian dish featuring chicken, wood-fired bake, and satvik-friendly ingredients, perfect for a crowd-pleasing dinner.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together berbere spice, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the marinade and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken and sprinkle with chopped onion.
Bake the chicken in the preheated wood-fired oven for 25-30 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the chicken from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
